<DOCSTRING>
Binds the string at the first unquoted special character (an @-sign or left angle bracket) that is not followed by a Unicode combining character.

Args:
    text (str): The input string to be split.
    specials (tuple[str, ...]): A tuple of special characters to look for.

Returns:
    tuple[str, str]: The left and right parts of the split string.

Raises:
    EmailSyntaxError: If no special character is found or if the full-width at-sign or small commercial at is used.
</DOCSTRING>
